definitions.explanation: The act of putting a product on sale or releasing it to the market for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{発売|はつばい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new smartphone will be released next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧{発売|はつばい}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{発売|はつばい}{日|び}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I waited in line and bought it on the release day.

notes:
USAGE: {発売|はつばい} is used for releasing products for sale, especially new products, tickets, or media.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発売|はつばい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to release, to put on sale)
- {発売|はつばい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be released)
- {発売|はつばい}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (now on sale)
- {発売|はつばい}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧ (sales start)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}{日|び}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧ (release date)
- {発売|はつばい}⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (publisher, distributor)
- ⟦{新|しん}→新：noentry⟧{発売|はつばい} (newly released)
- ⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧{発売|はつばい} (advance sale)
- {発売|はつばい}⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧ (release commemoration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ - sales (ongoing selling)
- ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ - publication, issuance
